intro: At the Biohackers World Conference in Miami, [Dr. Lauren Leiva](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/lauren-leiva), a renowned physical therapist and biohacker, had a conversation with Philipp Samor von Holtzendorff-Fehling, the founder of Leela Quantum Tech. Leela Quantum has been gaining attention for its revolutionary products that infuse everyday items with quantum energy, offering a new approach to improving health and wellbeing. In this blog, we dive deeper into their discussion and explore the science behind quantum energy, its potential applications, and how it might reshape the future of wellness.
highlights: Quantum energy underpins all matter and can enhance objects by infusing them with specific frequencies.
Leela Quantum Tech infuses products with quantum frequencies for wellness.
Quantum technology is integrated into water bottles and energy generators.
Biohackers use quantum-infused devices to speed up healing and personal growth.

blocks.text: What is Quantum Energy?

Quantum energy can sound like an abstract concept for those not familiar with the science behind it. In simple terms, quantum energy is the fundamental energy that underpins all matter in the universe. According to Philipp Samor von Holtzendorff-Fehling, Leela Quantum Tech’s products harness this energy to enhance the properties of objects by infusing them with quantum frequencies.

“Our technology allows us to infuse objects with quantum energy and combine that with specific frequencies — think of it as adding a vitamin C frequency or any other frequency to the energy,” said Philipp during the interview. Using quantum energy as a base layer, Leela’s products aim to provide a higher energetic quantum resonance that can positively influence the body.

This concept is not entirely new. The work of Dr. Masaru Emoto, who famously studied the effects of words on water molecules, is often cited in discussions around energy and frequencies. In fact, Leela Quantum Tech’s products were tested by Emoto’s Institute in Japan, where they were found to positively affect water in ways that surpassed the capabilities of any other products they had tested.
The Science Behind Quantum Energy

While quantum energy may sound like something out of science fiction, its impact on our everyday lives is becoming increasingly evident. As Philipp explains, quantum energy can be understood as the energy behind all matter. In fact, we are more than 99% water on a molecular level, but the real breakthrough comes when we understand that even behind this matter, there is space filled with quantum energy.

“Behind every matter, there’s space, and it’s not an empty space — it’s filled with quantum energy. All of our cells have a quantum field, which is how we can tap into this energy,” said Philipp. This idea challenges conventional understanding of the universe and opens up new possibilities for quantum energy therapy and holistic health care practices.
How To Use Quantum Technology in Everyday Life

Leela Quantum Tech is pioneering the integration of quantum energy into everyday products. From water bottles that infuse liquid with quantum energy to energy-generating devices, the company is creating tools designed to help people optimize their energy levels and promote better health.

For example, Leela Quantum Tech’s Quantum Energy Generators — such as the Corona Block — use quantum energy to enhance the environment. Even at its most basic level, the Corona Block was able to accelerate water’s molecular response to quantum frequencies faster than anything the Emoto Institute had seen before. This is just one example of how the technology can potentially affect the body’s molecular state for better health outcomes.
Quantum Healing Therapy as Biohacking Innovation

[Biohacking](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking) is about using technology and science to optimize health and performance, and quantum energy is a natural extension of this mindset. Many biohackers are turning to products like Leela Quantum Tech’s to gain a competitive edge in their wellness journey.

In the interview, Dr. Leiva discussed how she incorporates frequency and energy healing in her practice, mainly through sound healing and heart-opening exercises. These practices, she says, allow people to feel energy flow through their bodies. She also emphasized that biohacking tools, like quantum-infused products, can expedite healing and personal growth. Some of these tools may eventually be recognized as part of a broader field of alternative health technologies.

“Instead of working really hard, you can biohack your way to the goal, using tools like quantum-infused devices,” Dr. Leiva explained. This sentiment speaks to the increasing interest in quantum technologies to enhance traditional wellness methods. By allowing users to tap into quantum energy, these tools can speed up the biohacking process, enabling individuals to achieve their desired results faster than traditional methods. Some biohackers and wellness professionals are starting to integrate biohacking equipment in their wellness protocols, often based on quantum healing therapy.
Quantum Energy for Pets and Homes

Leela Quantum Tech’s offerings extend beyond human health. During their conversation, Philipp mentioned the company’s efforts to bring quantum energy technology into the lives of pets. With pet health on the rise, their products are being tested on animals, with some remarkable results. One study even featured a paralyzed dog that began running after just one day of treatment using quantum energy devices.

“The latest study we did involved 24 dogs, and one dog was in a dire condition, paralyzed and set to be put down. After just a day of treatment with our technology, that dog began to run in circles, something it hadn’t done in a long time,” Philipp shared. This underscores the growing potential for quantum energy to be applied across a wide range of species and health conditions.

Moreover, Leela Quantum Tech has expanded its product line to include quantum devices for the home and car, such as the Quantum Block and Infinity Block. These devices generate a quantum field that permeates spaces, potentially neutralizing harmful electromagnetic frequencies that have become pervasive in modern life. Some users describe them as an EMF protection device, designed to create a more harmonious environment that benefits both the body and mind.
The Future of Quantum Wellness

As quantum energy continues to gain traction in the wellness community, more studies and real-world applications will likely emerge. The possibilities for enhancing everything from home environments to personal health are vast. Whether it’s through [improved sleep](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-sleep), better hydration, or accelerated healing, quantum energy has the potential to revolutionize the way we approach wellbeing.
A promising direction for future research is understanding what is quantum biology, as this emerging field may explain how quantum technologies interact with living systems.

“People sometimes get caught up in the belief that they can’t see the energy, so they don’t believe in it. But you can feel it, and that’s the beauty of quantum energy. It’s something you can experience, even if you can’t see it,” Philipp concluded.

As we continue to explore the science behind quantum energy and its potential benefits, it’s clear that the intersection of technology, wellness, and biohacking is only beginning to unfold. With companies like Leela Quantum Tech leading the charge, it’s an exciting time to be at the forefront of a new wave of health optimization.
